dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed within the ARCADIA project in the context of the Ph.D. of Federica Carollo (Politecnico di Milano). The dataset relates to the landfilling of 1 kg of mixed construction and demolition (C&D) waste (EWC 17 09 04) in Italy. The original dataset " Inert waste {CH}| treatment of, sanitary landfill | Cut-off, U (Ecoinvent 3.3)" was modified as follows: it was added some site-specific values concerning an Italian inert landfill (taken from Blengini and Garbarino, 2010) (Process: Inert landfill operativity, Lombardy Region)

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription: Carollo F. (2023). Circularity in construction and demolition waste management chain, Ph.D. Dissertation (Tutored by Rigamonti L., Ceruti F.). Politecnico di Milano. Background datasets from the EcoInvent database cut-off (v. 3.8) were used for the LCA study.
